title: durable source becomes a digest-pinned static Plan with explicit data and control edges
notes: Both backends now observe the descriptor marker, node kinds, SHA-256 digest width, unwrap-to-branch control edge, sequential Action edge, and canonical sorted Action requirements. compiler/fork_durable_test.go additionally feeds this Plan shape through the TypeScript PlanArtifact validator. The JS reference previously reported SMITHERS4100 at 7:24 because the standalone compileDurableSource accepted Action contracts only as caller-supplied descriptor bindings, which no in-module Action can provide; poc/src/durable/source-compiler.ts now derives the contract of every same-file `class X extends Action<Signature>` from its own checked program (the shared derivation lives in poc/src/durable/schema.ts, so a derived contract and a pre-compiled one are the same descriptor), and reports the consumed declarations so a consumer can erase them with the compiler-owned import. Descriptor bindings remain optional and are now only for Actions imported from modules this single-source pass cannot see. SOURCE NARROWED 2026-08-28, expectation unchanged. `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` became enforced (compatibility.mdx §Mandatory, previously unimplemented), and this program read an index without narrowing, so it was correctly refused. §Mandatory's own guidance is that such a read 'MUST be narrowed, or read through an extraction helper'. The narrowing is inert at run time — the guard never fires — so the stdout this case pins is byte-for-byte what it was, re-derived by running both backends.
